one_liner: Firecrawl offers a REST API for search, scrape, crawl, map, interact and more. It has a free tier with an API key, OAuth for apps, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys (fc-...) are found in the dashboard. The API reference points to "OAuth for apps" so users can connect their own Firecrawl account to your app. The OAuth details (flow, token prefixes) were not in the fetched pages. Composio lists only API_KEY. Some endpoints (scrape, search, parse) also work keyless.
access_notes: The free plan gives 1,000 credits per month with no card. Scrape, search and parse also work keyless with per-IP daily caps. Heavier use needs a paid plan.
blocker_notes: No blocker. A free key is self-serve. Free credits are limited, so heavy use needs a paid plan.
